title: Signal Runner
description: A fast-paced game concept combining movement, rhythm, and clear visual cues.
imageAlt: Futuristic player character on a glowing track

content.heading: The Idea
paragraphs: Signal Runner explores how a small number of precise cues can make a fast-paced experience easy to read. Movement and obstacles follow a shared visual rhythm.

content.heading: The Prototype
paragraphs: The playable prototype focuses on movement, immediate feedback, and short iteration cycles. Systems and visuals were developed together so that every mechanic remains easy to understand.
